reviews.comment: The Smoky Paneer Sizzler arrived piping hot with unforgettable char. Our favorite dinner spot in Ahmedabad!
Crispy Masala Dosa paired with freshly pulled Espresso and a warm Classic Butter Croissant is unbeatable.
Loved the Korean Spicy Duo and Cinnamon Roll. Wish delivery packaging had extra lime wedges.
